comments: Amazing location. Three minute walk to great restaurant, acropolis, and famous Athen streets. Transfer from airport to apt was absolutely great and pleasant. House is designed beautifully.
name: Great design Acropolis apartment

comments:
Gute lage,ruhig, alles war ok.
Danke für alles.03.2015
name: Modern 1BR w/ Balcony | Local Athens Neighborhood

comments: There are some positive and some negatives about the house. The biggest positive is the location which is very close to syntagma square and to most touristic areas. On the other side, the furniture is very old, the kitchen is very small there is no space to even  have one dish where you can peel an apple. But the worst is that the flat has no window!!!! So if you are claustrophobic do not even think of living here. The windows shown in the photos are opening to a wall just half meter far. When at home you can not understand if it is cloudy or raining outside.  The flat is on the ground floor and most probably was built for the doorkeeper of the apartment. When doorkeepers where existing .
name: Vintage Apartment Athens, Plaka (Historic Center)

comments:
I have travelled a lot - and this is one of the most beautiful flats I have ever lived in. The most stunning view of the Acropolis you can imagine. The apartment - extremely tasteful. Only one tiny little disadvantage - 3 floors below is a little shoe factory, so from time to time you hear a little rumbling. Agis is a great guy. When you arrive he gives you a list with all the in-places of Athens.

GO!!
name: Athens AVATON - Parthenon Suite

comments: Annonce 100% conforme au descriptif ilias est très rapide pour la moindre questions ou doutes concernant le voyage prévu en l'occurrence une logistique pour une famille avec 2 enfants. Un réel confort d'avoir quelqu'un qui est venu nous chercher à l'aéroport et malgré 1h de retard sur l'arrivée le tarif est resté celui annoncé initialement. Accès aux attractions d'Athènes bien, un ensemble de documentation à disposition ainsi qu une immense carte murale dans le bureau permet de mieux préparer ses déplacements commerces de proximité bien, le personnel de la boulangerie à côté au top, une bonne surprise avec un marché le jeudi de fruits et légumes, le quartier est calme.
name: By the hill

comments: The view is great, but it does not include any of the main tourist attractions, and there is a great deal of traffic noise on the balcony from the intersection of several main arteries. The neighborhood is quiet at street level, and nicer if you cross the river to the north - see Host’s recommendations for venues. Close to metro, yes, direct line to Plaka area. The bed, sheets and pillows were good. There is plenty of hot water when heated, but the shower has a low ceiling – duck if you’re over 5’8”. The Host was out of country, and no one was there to check me in or out, other arrangements were made. The wifi connection was terrible to non-existent; the host’s “friend” came twice to try to fix it, but he also went out of town for part of my 13-day stay and the problem persisted to the end, I had to go to internet cafes a few times. I was able to cook a few basic meals with what was provided in the kitchen - microwave, cook top, no oven. Floors and counter were not as clean as I would have liked. The place needs TLC and better management.
name: Panoramic city view, quiet neighborhood near metro

comments:
Alkis apartment was clean, tidy and as it appeared in the photos. It is very cosy and we had a comfortable and enjoyable stay. The local area was ok, with a well stocked supermarket only a few minutes walk away and it was under a 30 minute walk to the centre, including the area of the Acropolis.
Before and during our stay Alkis was very communicative, helpful and always quick to reply. He answered all of the questions I had and suggested a fantastic restaurant to visit during our stay. Alkis was a great host and went out of his way to make sure we had a pleasant and easy stay.
The apartment is next to a train line, which was quite noisy when trains were passing; this would happen every morning from around 6 or 7am so was a bit disruptive to sleep. The kitchen supplies were quite basic, with no bowls or chopping/bread knives.
However we still had a lovely stay and would recommend the apartment.
name: Gazi Boutique Apartment 2

comments: Everything was perfect! Nice and very clean apartment in the center of Athens. Perfect for two adults or a little famile of three. The area is nice with lots of restaurants where you meet the locals and not only tourists. You can walk to the  interesting things or easily go by bus.  We loved to stay in Mikas apartment. And appreciated all the help she gave about places to see. Highly recommended!
name: Cosy apartment! Great central Athens location!

comments: I enjoyed my stay there so much that I stayed an additional 4 nights. It's a very comfy place with a wonderful terrasse and view. I really love the area, great local businesses and the park is a minute walk away :) I highly recommend staying there!
name: Sunny appartment near Athens centre

comments:
Yagos' flat is in an interesting, vibrant part of Athens that's very conveniently located for getting about the city. The huge roof terrace garden is a real highlight of the flat. My partner and I spent two very enjoyable days there.

Yagos is a friendly, thorough and communicative host and it was a pleaure dealing with him.
name: LUSCIOUS ROOF GARDEN IN THE CENTER!

comments: The apartment is in an awesome location and he is great! We are staying there again when we pass through Athens!
name: Hermes Historical Center apt.

comments:
"Richard's airbnb is wonderful on all aspects. It is spacious, 2 balconies and very confortable and cozy. It is very clean and welcoming, and the neighbors are lovely. It is very accessible : you can come easily by metro from the airport and is close to all the sights : museums, the Acropolis, gardens, and all the best neighborhoods (Place, Syntagma..)
The price is very reasonable for such quality ! It is well equipped and Richard is very nice, he gave us much information and help to get around, buy groceries, eat food and visit the city. I would highly recommend staying here, the neighborhood is quiet and charming. Thank you again Richard for making our visit to Athens so amazing !" Calypso
name: Modern apartment in city centre - great location

comments: Loved our stay at Anna’s place. Could not have been a more central location and Anna was a fabulous host!
name: Vintage Apartment Athens, Plaka (Historic Center)

comments: The apartment was very cute and spacious for 2 people. The location is very central and a skip / step away from a lot of the major attractions.  Anna was a good host. Very personable and accommodating. Anna made us feel right at home. The airline lost our luggage and she provided us with a phone charger and was always asking us about our luggage. Overall a great stay.
name: Vintage Apartment Athens, Plaka (Historic Center)

comments:
Perfection! This stay was everything it promised through the photos and description.
We were in the heart of a great area right near Plaka. The condo is so close to everything- shops, bars, restaurants, tourist sights, and a grocery store. Everything was between a 2 and 10 minute walk with a cute bar/restaurant literally right outside the door.
-The view is just unbelievable
-The condo was cleaned to perfection and well maintained.
-The bed and couch were both super comfortable.
-The kitchen was very well stocked with modern dishes, prep tools and equipment.
-The shower was a work of art with great water pressure and great water temperature.
-George and Agis were very easy to communicate with and made check in seamless.
-We felt safe the entire time.
We don’t have a single complaint other than we wish we could live here full time! We will definitely stay here again.
name: Athens AVATON - Parthenon Suite

comments: This house is great. In the heart of the city , beautiful and clean with everything you may need for a quick or a long stay.
name: Modern apartment in city centre - great location

comments: Rich's apartment was very clean and tidy. There was everything you needed for a comfortable stay. I can recommend this place 100%
name: Modern apartment in city centre - great location

comments: Fantastic apartment with everything you need, Stephen was really helpful with any questions.
name: SUNNY | CENTRAL | COZY | CONVENIENT

comments: Anna made us feel very welcome and her apartment was amazing! Definitely a huge fan of the location as it's close to Plaka yet also private.
name: Vintage Apartment Athens, Plaka (Historic Center)

comments: Really nice and charming appartement in the center of Athènes. Anna was really nice. She let everything for us in the appartement also to take our breakfast. Really near from the acropole by walk. Thanks you
name: Vintage Apartment Athens, Plaka (Historic Center)

comments: Alkis' appartment was immaculate and spacious. The directional instructions were clear, and the photographs were very accurate. He made himself available at all times in the event of an unlikely issue. It was conveniently close to an underground station (5 minute walk). I would recommend a stay here for your visit.
name: Gazi Boutique Apartment 2

comments: Stephen place was great 👍 everything we expected and more . Will def comeback.
name: SUNNY | CENTRAL | COZY | CONVENIENT

comments: Excellent accueil par Nasos qui est même venu nous chercher à la sortie du métro. Emplacement de l'appartement parfait avec toutes les principales attractions d'Athenes à proximité. Quartier tranquille (bien qu'il soit au cœur de la vie athénienne. Seul petit bémol, le bain nécessiterait des rénovations. Ceci dit l'appartement demeure très propre.
name: Studio Under Acropolis Rock

comments:
We hebben een top verblijf gehad in het appartement van Richard.
We hadden een auto gehuurd en de instructies om bij het appartement te komen waren erg duidelijk. Ook was de communicatie met Richard vlot en vriendelijk
Bij aankomst stonden er een drankjes in de koelkast klaar, wat erg fijn was met het warme weer. Het appartement was van alle gemakken voorzien en erg schoon.
Het centrum en bezienswaardigheden zoals het Acropolis of de wijk Plakka zijn op loofafstand, rond de 15-20 minuten, waardoor dit een mooie locatie is om de Athene te verkennen.
Ik raad het appartement van Richard iedereen aan mocht je Athene willen bezoeken
name: Modern apartment in city centre - great location

comments:
Everything was nice, as expected. No problems whatsoever.
Ilias was really friendly and helpfull :)
I would recomend this place to everyone traveling to Athens.
name: By the hill

comments: We had a fantastic stay in Athens in Pygmalion's apartment - lovely and bright, clean and felt just like home! The bed was particularly comfortable, and we enjoyed cooking some simple meals at home in the well-organised kitchen after visiting Athens central markets. The apartment is in a great residential neighborhood that gives you a taste of the real Athens - we enjoyed visiting local bakeries and cafes! Thanks for a great stay Pygmalion!
name: Modern 1BR w/ Balcony | Local Athens Neighborhood

comments: Vivian & Minto's place was exactly what we were after - a calm space to unwind after exploring and some remote working. Their patio was full of beautiful plants, which was a huge bonus :)
name: Sunny appartment near Athens centre

comments: Très bon accueil, hôtes très réactifs qui n'hésitent pas à donner de bonnes adresses. L'appartement est très bien situé et facile d'accès. Très bien équipé, tout a bien fonctionné (lave-vaisselle, machine à laver). Très propre et spacieux, rien à redire. Il y a même un parking, ce qui peut être utile. Le métro n'est qu'à 10 minutes à pieds, ce qui permet de se déplacer facilement dans Athènes et ses environs. Le quartier est très calme que ce soit en journée ou le soir. La terrasse est vraiment le point fort : avec vue sur l'Acropole et toute la ville, les soirées sont très agréables. L'appartement est conforme aux descriptions. Si vous décidez d'y passer quelques jours, votre séjour ne peut être qu'agréable !
name: Urban Forty One | Acropolis-view penthouse

comments:
Pasamos 3 días en el departamento de Nasos, que tuvo la amabilidad de esperarnos a la salida de la estación de metro, acompañarnos e indicarnos todo lo que necesitabamos saber para nuestra estadía, siempre estuvo en contacto para ver si todo iba bien.
El departamento es amplio, comodo y tiene todo lo que se necesita, la ubicacion es espectacular, cerca de absolutamente todo lo que hay que ver. Sin dudas volveríamos
name: Studio Under Acropolis Rock

comments: Agis really goes above and beyond with listing.  the room itself is modern chic and the view is unbeatable, he provides tons of little extras like physically being there for the check in to offer recommendations,  tidbits, and arranging transfers for us.  the entrance to the building and  lower floors can be a little shocking at first but that was in no way representative of what you are getting with this room
name: Athens AVATON - Parthenon Suite

comments: Excellently appointed beautiful apartment.  Host Dimitris is a gem.  Wonderful spot!!
name: Hermes Historical Center apt.

comments: Great location, everything you need or want to see is really close by. The room was absolutely fine for a couple.
name: Studio Under Acropolis Rock

comments: Small but very cute and modern. Perfect for a couple or individual traveler. Ultra convenient to the Acropolis and everything else in the middle of Athens. Highly recommended!
name: Studio Under Acropolis Rock

comments:
Vivian and Minto are really nice hosts.
They came to pick us up af the airport for a fair fee and gave an amount of useful suggestions and informations.
The apartment is nice and well kept and has a great view from the balcony.
You can find lot of food for breakfast in the refrigerator, fresh fruits and home-made oil and liquors.
Strogly recommended to everyone!
name: Sunny appartment near Athens centre

comments: It was great experience
name: Modern apartment in city centre - great location

comments: I was in the apartment for one week and had a lovely stay. It is exactly as shown in the photos and - while lacking in natural light - it's not lacking a bit in charm. It's a very cozy space with just about everything you would need (from excellent wi-fi to delicious homemade jams). The Plaka location is perfect and just a few steps away from many restaurants, shops, and attractions. An easy walk to Parliament (for the changing of the guards) or the Acropolis (for beautiful history and breathtaking views of the city). Anna was a great host and was very helpful in letting me know about transportation options and where to find things in the neighborhood. If you're interested, there is a friendly-staffed Starbucks within 5 minutes walking distance, a lovely vegetarian restaurant (Avocado) within 2 minutes walking, and a great yoga studio (Bhavana Yoga) within 10 minutes walking. I truly enjoyed my visit and I would definitely stay here again.
name: Vintage Apartment Athens, Plaka (Historic Center)

comments:
I kept waking up in the middle of the night to just check and make sure that the view was real and really there. I can't imagine a more spectacular view than the splendid panorama out of Agis's window. We had a straight shot to the Acropolis. Breathtaking! Heart stopping! I never tired of looking out those huge windows.
In addition, the apartment was so cool. Urban industrial chic. Dark and atmospheric--but then that view from virtually every corner of the apartment. The kitchen had everything we needed and was easy to keep clean. The bathroom was dramatically lighted and here as well--easy to keep clean. The shower was great. There was a forest of closets and drawers that helped us to settle in as if we were staying for a month. The bed was delicious--so comfortable. So when I woke up to check on the view (still there!) I quickly fell back to sleep.
This is the only apartment we'll stay in in Athens.
name: Athens AVATON - Parthenon Suite

comments:
Chiming in with all the other positive reviews, our stay at Rich’s place has been absolutely splendid.
The apartment is great value for money, and Rich is so attentive and hospitable. Central, yet quiet location. Would definitely stay again.
name: Modern apartment in city centre - great location

comments: Very great location just 7 minutes walk to city center. Public transport, market and coffee nearby. And it's quiet at night. There's 3 beds so the flat is very nice for family or friends. And our host is very nice and accommodating, it's a great experience in Athens !
name: Hermes Historical Center apt.

comments: We've had a great stay at Richard's place. The flat is big, with 3 bedrooms (each with a balcony, too!), which was very convenient. It was also very clean and fully equipped. And the location is great - only 1-2 stops from the city center, by metro; which is excatly what we were looking for - a quiet neighborhood, but such that is also lively (there are quite many restaurants and cafe's around), and easy to get from to the center. Richards had been extremely communicative and responsive; and so was Donna - we had a small problem with the bathroom, but she arrived in no time to handle that. All in all - great experience, and a great value for your money!
name: Modern apartment in city centre - great location

comments: Als Familie habe wir uns sehr wohl gefühlt bei Richard! Er hat uns auch tolle Tipps für die Umgebung und vor allem Ägina empfohlen ! Tausend Dank!!!
name: Modern apartment in city centre - great location

comments: Amazing place to stay with a good location near Kerameikos metro stop. Apartment is big and clean and really nicely furnished! Would definitely stay again if I returned to Athens
name: Gazi Boutique Apartment 2

comments: Very good stay. The charming apartment has perfect location in the city center. Rothantie and Anna are very thoughtful, they prepare everything you might need in the apartment and care about the well being of the guest during their stay.
name: Vintage Apartment Athens, Plaka (Historic Center)

comments: Had a blast! Awesome apartment!
name: Athens AVATON - Parthenon Suite

comments: Great location for visiting all the main sites of Athens. On a quiet street but lots of restaurants close by. Walk or take subway every where. Large comfortable space. As Haris states it is his home so lots of personal touches. Haris was very accommodating, helpful and friendly.
name: Quiet Courtyard • 2BR • 95sqm • Acropolis Walk

comments:
The apartment is perfect. Modern and very clean, with a comfortable bed and a well-stocked kitchen.
The location is fine - really quiet neighborhood and not so far from the metro station.
I would definitely stay here again!
Thanks Pygmalion and Stella.
name: Modern 1BR w/ Balcony | Local Athens Neighborhood

comments: Ilias's house is a quirky, tastefully decorated place that's warm and welcoming. It's exactly as it appears in the photos. All the basics are taken care of. The nearest metro station is a 10-15 min walk. Lots of restaurants and cafes nearby within walking distance and a super market right opposite the house. We were a party of 3 adults and 2 kids, aged 4 years and 7 years and the kids loved the space the house provided. Ilias is super responsive - both before and during our stay, replying to my many messages literally within minutes. He was there to receive us though we arrived late around 10 pm and he was there to see us off at 6 am! Ilias arranged smooth taxi transfers from the airport both ways and everything done very professionally, promptly and yet with a lot of warmth and personal attention.  Ilias is a great host and I'd definitely recommend his lovely house for a stay in Athens.
name: By the hill

comments: The views are absolutely breathtaking and the location is great! It’s close to so many restaurants and bars! Agis and his host George were so accommodating and helpful!
name: Athens AVATON - Parthenon Suite

comments: I had such a wonderful stay here. I was so pleased to have a terrace and safety door. I felt comfortable in the area and it was great to be close to the bus, supermarket and local restaurants. It was also a blessing to have air con in the 40degree heat! I was able to use the internet to do my work and so was very pleased. Thank you!
name: Sunny appartment near Athens centre

comments: Katerina’s accomodation was so good! So close to the train station and buses, so easy to get around and a 10-15min trip into the centre. Accomodation was spacious and clean!
name: Spacious Cosy aprtm very close to Metro!

comments: Vassillis is a great host, picked up four of us at the airport, managed to fit us in his car, and provided us with everything we needed. We had trouble with the lock and he gladly helped us.  I would not recommend the place for four people but I would for three people.  The double sofa bed is not very comfortable for two people.  However, for three people, it is a great place with an amazing view of the city.
name: Panoramic city view, quiet neighborhood near metro

comments: Vassilis went out of his way to help us & gave very helpful transport advice. The view is better than the photos.
name: Panoramic city view, quiet neighborhood near metro

comments: Excelente lugar para pasar una estancia muy grata en Atenas. El lugar es como se indica y Anna es una host muy amable y proactiva.
name: Vintage Apartment Athens, Plaka (Historic Center)

comments:
We spent two nights at Nasos' apartment and loved it. Nasos picked us up from Syntagma station, and walked us to the apartment, which is smack in the heart of it all. Only a few minutes walk from the Akropolis, the Akropolis museum, Roman and ancient agora, the Arch of Hadrian and so on.
The apartment itself was perfect for two people, and the AC was very welcome given the hot temperatures in Athens. Nasos had water, cookies and a couple of snacks waiting for us, which was brilliant for two very jet-lagged people.
While you're there, make sure you try out Thanasis' Kebabs, and A for Athens for an amazing night rooftop view of the Akropolis.
Nasos was a fantastic host and we would definitely stay here again.
name: Studio Under Acropolis Rock

comments:
We had a great time staying at Nasos' apartment. It was spacious enough for a couple even though its a studio. The location couldn't be better, right in the heart of Athens yet lovely and quiet.
The bed was one of the best I have ever slept in ;)
Nasos had left all the essential supplies in the bathroom which was much appreciated. He also met us at the station and took us back to the apartment which was very kind and helpful.
Great stay and a great host.
name: Studio Under Acropolis Rock

comments: host was responsive, location was nice and the place is super cosy
name: Modern 1BR w/ Balcony | Local Athens Neighborhood

comments: Nasos met us at the Metro station to make sure we got to store our luggage as we arrived pretty early in the morning. Then he met us again at check in time to guide us to the apartment, give us a quick tour of the apartment, and then took the time to highlight places that we should check out around town! The location is fantastic-the weather was chilly in the morning, hot during the day, and cold at night-and the central location of the apartment made it easy for me to pop in and grab a sweater when I needed to. The neighborhood is SUPER quiet at all times of the day/night. There's a little balcony with a cute view of the orange/lemon trees below and it's the perfect spot to enjoy breakfast. There is a "Bazaar" supermarket that is fairly close by where you can pick up a few items- but Nasos has graciously provided a LOT of toiletries and snacks!
name: Studio Under Acropolis Rock

comments:
I had a short but lovely stay in Athens thanks to Pygmalion. His apartment was clean and comfy just as pictured. He was a great host,
good recommendations, and very accommodating!
name: Modern 1BR w/ Balcony | Local Athens Neighborhood

comments: All was fine with our stay at V's apartment. It is convenient, being an easy 5 minute walk from the Metro station which is just 7 direct stops away from the central Monastiraki station (approx 20 mins). It is in a functional area with supermarkets and bakeries. We couldn't find a free parking space on the street after 10 minutes and so paid £10 for 24hr in a very nearby carpark.
name: Panoramic city view, quiet neighborhood near metro

comments: L'appartement est très bien situé dans le centre d'Athènes. L'appartement est aussi très bien équipé et confortable. Dimitris était très sympa et très accueillant. Nous avons eu un agréable séjour et y retourneront certainement.
name: Hermes Historical Center apt.

comments: Amazing views and walkable to just about everything. This flat exceeded our expectations which were already high from the photos. Highly recommended!
name: Athens AVATON - Parthenon Suite

comments: Wow. First of all, Agis is incredibly helpful, flexible and friendly. He must also be a maniac (in the nicest possible way) because the attention to detail in the flat is out of this world. There is everything there for a super stay. And this is before one starts even to talk about the flat: this place is better than any five star stay one might have in the city. It is located within walking distance of the main sites, it has breathtaking views and it is luxurious in design and quality of space. I would have loved to stay for longer and the first thing I did upon leaving was to call a friend about to go through Athens and tell them to try to get it for their stay. We absolutely LOVED IT. Hats off. X
name: Athens AVATON - Parthenon Suite

comments: lovely apartment, exactly as described.  Clean, well maintained, all the amenities and then some.  Met us as planned, helped with restaurant and market ideas.  Great stay!
name: Urban Forty One | Acropolis-view penthouse

comments:
Enchanté de notre séjour, l'appartement était très bien dans une résidence au calme. La terrasse était un plus, située sur cour donc pas de bruit. Appartement bien aménagé
Hôte très réactif. je peux que le conseiller.
name: Modern 1BR w/ Balcony | Local Athens Neighborhood

comments: This is a gem --perfect location, well appointed, super easy to use as a base. The metro was right around the corner, a small shop with food necessities nearby. The flat itself is pristine and elegant. Airport transfers were offered and turned out to be a great idea--I got more Greek history and local tips from the drivers than I would have imagined! A truly lovely place in Athens.
name: Great design Acropolis apartment

comments: Une amie de Soula nous a reçue. Bien gentille personne qui nous a fait visiter les lieux. Appartement impecable, très propre, bien équipé, sécuritaire et décoré avec goût. Bien situé à 10 minutes de marche de l'Acropolis. Je vous le recomnande, vous ne serez pas déçu.
name: Unique Central Artistic Flat Athens

comments: Agis is unbelievablely attentive to a fault. The place is beautiful, the view is gorgeous and the black out curtains and shades make it easy to enjoy the view and to rest. The shower is cozy and the layout of the apartment overall is welcoming and functional. We stayed here for our wedding here and from the beginning Agis made us feel like we were at home. I cannot say enough about how amazing our stay was. The neighborhood overlooks a more rustic side of Athens and a mix of different styles of buildings, but the views of the Parthenon are truly spectacular and there is so much to eat and walk around to to give you a feel for downtown Athens. There is an amazing coffee shop across the street for 1-3 euros for Freddo cappuccino. It is very easy to find good things like this to eat for relatively cheap and we haven’t eaten anything nearby we didn’t love. The neighborhoods stays up relatively late and each street has so much personality. We walked easily to Monastiraki market and to the Parthenon. Parking is a bit more of a challenge but cabs were very easy to flag down. It was the perfect place for us to take amazing getting ready shots. We will have to be back for our anniversary. Thank you Agis!!!!
name: Athens AVATON - Parthenon Suite

comments: I ve been in Athens for many times, this is the best ! everything is perfect!!
name: Athens AVATON - Parthenon Suite

comments: Our host was great! Her husband met us at the apartment when and showed us every where to go around the city, as well as everything with the apartment to make sure that we would have a great time. They also let us checked out late, which was great since our flight left at night the day of checking out.
name: Great design Acropolis apartment

comments: Very comfortable, nice and spacious.
name: Gazi Boutique Apartment 1

comments: Nasos met us at the metro. He walked us to his apartment. There he showed us how things worked and gave us maps and information about Athens. He was very helpful. The next day he sent us a text to check if everything was OK.
name: Studio Under Acropolis Rock

comments: Great place, next to Acropolis and to main sites, very comfortable, clean and safe. Great hospitality
name: Studio Under Acropolis Rock

comments:
This flat is amazing and being only one stop away from the city centre is a real bonus. I visited Greece around February, when it was slightly cold, but the heating system works very well. At first I didn’t know how to switch it on, but Rich kindly explained it to us.
Everything in the flat was very clean and well organised. The kitchen is well equipped with a kettle, toaster, microwave, electric hob and oven, which was a big plus for me. Sometimes I prefer cooking while on holiday as I can get a bit tired of eating out all the time.
Rich provided us with plenty of helpful guidance, which is something many other Airbnb hosts do not offer. He is very knowledgeable and always responded to my messages straight away.
If I had to rate the flat, I would definitely give it 10 out of 10. The location is excellent as it is close to shops, local food places and the metro station.
I would highly recommend this Airbnb and will definitely stay here again whenever I visit Athens.
name: Modern apartment in city centre - great location

comments: This apartment is beautiful, super well located, and comfortable. Andreas is a great host and takes time to tell you about Athens and some great restaurants and sites near the apartment. There’s shampoo, soap, toilet paper that you can actually throw in the toilet and some starter groceries so you can have coffee or tea without making a trip to the store. There’s even wine and beer! The airport transportation is the icing on the cake - so convenient! One of the nicest Airbnb‘s I’ve ever used!
name: SV Acropolis Residence - Garden Suite with Hot Tub

comments: Great location with the best view in Athens. Very nice upgraded apartment with fantastic air conditioning.
name: Athens AVATON - Parthenon Suite

comments: The apartment was beautiful and very modern! Everything was closeby and easily accessible as mentioned. Her mother welcomed us and was more than happy to give us a tour of the apartment!
name: Great design Acropolis apartment

comments: This place was a great location.It was in a area that is full of life.lots of restaurants just a walk away. The apartment was in great condition supper clean fresh towels and  more!!  The beds were so comfortable and the pills were so nice.I definitely recommend this place.
name: Gazi Boutique Apartment 1

comments:
Excellent as always !
I always prefer to stay at alkis
Extremely clean apartment!
name: Gazi Boutique Apartment 1

comments: Rich's apartment was perfect for our family's stay in the great city of Athens. Rich went above and beyond in providing tourist info and clear instructions and this made the stay very smooth and relaxing. We would recommend Rich's place heartily and would love to stay again if we return to Athens.
name: Modern apartment in city centre - great location

comments: This apartment was okay for the few days that we were in Athens. It wasn’t amazing and anything extra that most Airbnb’s just include at least in our experiences (washer, coffee, extra blankets) was always an extra charge and you have to ask for it prior to arrival.
name: Gazi Boutique Apartment 1

comments: The apartment is perfect if you want something close to town in a nice, quiet neighborhood. It is safe, clean, and exactly as I expected based on the photos. Pygmalion is a great host. We showed up to the apartment earlier than expected because I accidentally gave him the wrong landing time, but he came right over and was at the apartment within 20 minutes of me calling him. He let us in, showed us around, and let us leave our bags there while we went and got dinner and the place was prepared. He gave us great recommendations and checked in with us about half way through the trip to see how we were doing. I would definitely stay here again.
name: Modern 1BR w/ Balcony | Local Athens Neighborhood

comments: We’d stay here again. If you want a quiet place to stay... haha with the exception of a choir of signing cats our first night.. you’ll enjoy this stay. We found a restaurant nearby that served great food, a nice farmers market, and some enjoyed doing some cooking.
name: Modern 1BR w/ Balcony | Local Athens Neighborhood

comments: Excellent accueil, l'appartement est très beau et l'hote très présent et réceptif! L'appartement est propre et détient tout ce dont on a besoin. Le seul petit hic: un concert de cloches à proxinité qui dure très longtemps.
name: Modern 1BR w/ Balcony | Local Athens Neighborhood

comments:
In any respect my stay at Anna's apartment was much more than expected: Already weeks before my actual arrival Anna started communicating in the most helpful and friendly way, and by the time I arrived I had almost the feeling we'd have been knowing each other for a long time.
The apartment itself is as beautiful as depicted in the photos, but Anna prepared a few extras that really surprised me in the most enjoyable way, including a fridge filled with all the ingredients for Greek salad!
The neighbourhood felt 100% safe, and by the time I left, I felt as leaving from a 2nd home!
During my whole stay I could absolutely feel that Anna would be standing by if there was anything I would have needed. And I particularly liked that she came to say Goodbye when I had to leave for the airport.
Thanks for everything!
name: Vintage Apartment Athens, Plaka (Historic Center)

comments:
Location location location. Close to everything you want to see in Athens.
But not just location. Anna is a great host, with good advice, who helped in anything I needed. The apartment is very well equipped with everything you might need, with a very homey feeling.
name: Vintage Apartment Athens, Plaka (Historic Center)

comments: Stephen was very attentive at our initial meeting and was very friendly in showing us around the apartments and its facilities. He went to some length to ensure that if any issues came to light then we could contact him without any problem. We felt very reassured by his attention and friendliness. The apartment provided a good base for our sightseeing of Athens and is generally in a good area ( and significantly better than some other areas we happened to pass through )
name: SUNNY | CENTRAL | COZY | CONVENIENT

comments: Anna is AWESOME.  Her place is central and very easy to find and get in and out of....she is a great host and she has a nice place to stay in Athens - right in the heart of all the action.
name: Vintage Apartment Athens, Plaka (Historic Center)

comments: Great stay in Athens at Nasos Place. He was so kind and helped with our very heavy bags, gave us lots advice about where to go / eat / drink. Fantastic location, clean and everything we needed for a 3 night stay. Thank you very much.
name: Studio Under Acropolis Rock

comments: Perfect location to walk or grab a tram to whatever you’re wanting to do in and around Athens. We had a later afternoon flight and were very happy to get a later check out. Would definitely recommend or come back if we are in Athens again.
name: Unique Central Artistic Flat Athens

comments: Amazing place to stay. Safe area. Appartments comfortable and clean and welcoming. Any questions just ask Aris is a great host. View is a highlight
name: Athens AVATON - Parthenon Suite

comments: Rich a été un hôte aux petits soins, nous avons du adapter notre séjour en raison de grèves prévues le 1 er mai et Richard a été très flexible et nous a aidé à trouver les informations utiles sur les sites d'information grecs. un hôte toujours disponible et très serviable. Le logement est propre, spacieux, bien placé, et parfait pour une famille avec enfants. nous recommandons vivement!
name: Modern apartment in city centre - great location

comments: 5 star hotel quality everything with the convenience of full kitchen with microwave and toaster, beautiful outdoor patio and of course hot tub.
name: SV Acropolis Residence - Garden Suite with Hot Tub

comments: Ilias greeted us at the late hour of 3am, explained the house and made sure we had taxi service while also ensuring we had everything we needed. Great location to hike the Areopagus. Wonderful man.
name: By the hill

comments:
Our stay was excellent.
The apartment has many advantages:
- Fantastic location, very close to all sites and transport
- Safe environment
- Recently renovated
- Clean and accurate
- Spacious
Anna is a great host, very responsive and helpful.
The only point is absence of sunlight, because all windows look into a kind of shaft between the buildings. However, this construction provides surprisingly good natural ventilation and looks totally safe; if you use the apartment for night sleeping (as we did), you would hardly notice any problem.
name: Vintage Apartment Athens, Plaka (Historic Center)

comments:
Nice little apartment. Situated virtually 30 seconds from a supermarket. Also, less than 5 minutes walk from the metro that can take you anywhere.
Very late at night the area can seem dangerous if alone. The apartment locks up like a fortress but be careful on your way to the place if alone.
name: Gazi Boutique Apartment 1

comments: Wehad just arrived in Greece after dark. We were met at the subway which was so helpful to getting oriented.
name: Studio Under Acropolis Rock

comments: Great value, nice balcony
name: Sunny appartment near Athens centre

comments: Alles war in Teig & Gleis! Vassilis war immer gut erreichbar und stets bemüht unsere Fragen zu beantworten. Die Aussicht auf die Stadt vom Balkon ist premium! :-)
name: Panoramic city view, quiet neighborhood near metro

comments: An apartment in a very central and easy to navigate place in Athens with a wonderful host who goes above and beyond to help guests and make herself available!
name: Vintage Apartment Athens, Plaka (Historic Center)

comments: We were made to feel very welcome after a long journey. Katerina brought us a lovely fresh bowl of fruit. Very easy access to metro.
name: Spacious Cosy aprtm very close to Metro!

comments:
Rich is a super host. He gave us detailed and useful information and supported us even if it was not in Athens.
The apartment is great and clean, well-furnished, equipped with all comforts and a fantastic balcony.
Also the position is very close to the center and cool for the night.
Super recommended.
name: Modern apartment in city centre - great location

comments: Eine kleine, sehr gemütliche Wohnung, die ein super Ausgangspunkt ist für das Erkunden der Stadt. Kipseli ist ein tolles Viertel - ich habe es sehr genossen, die Wohung zu verlassen und mich sofort wohl zu fühlen :)
name: Sunny appartment near Athens centre

comments:
Ilias, his family and his apartment are fantastic! From beginning to end, Ilias was attentive and super helpful. He arranged a taxi for us from the airport when we arrived late and to the port when we left early. His dad met us to let us in because he was out of town. Our luggage didn't make it until a day after we did so Illias lent my husband and I few tshirts until our bags arrived. When they did, he had them delivered to his mom's house (a couple blocks away) so we wouldn't miss any time sight seeing. He met us when we left early for the port. We accidentally took the house key with us when we left for Santorini, but Illias was very gracious and patient waiting for us to return in ten days and bring the key back to him.

He was very attentive with messaging and making arrangements for us and recommending places for us to go: bakery and souvleki.

The apartment is located convenient to many things (Fillapapou Hill, Acropolis and museum, Roman Agora, ext) all of which we walked to. It is clean and spacious and has a lot of character.

What can we say, we loved it! My only regret is that we didn't get to spend more time with him.

A short note about another review: I did not find the mattress to be too hard. Throwing toilet paper in the basket and not the toilet is common in many other countries, including latin america where we have traveled quite a bit so we did not find this to be a problem at all.
name: By the hill

comments: Beautiful Condo and great location! Host responded quickly and has a book for her guest full of very useful information about her apartment and the Beautiful City of Athens. Highly recommend place. Sorry that i had to move lots of stuff for our 1 6 month old baby to avoid breaking the beautiful decoration that gives lots of life to Soula's place.
name: Unique Central Artistic Flat Athens

comments: Excellent views, good location, nice bars and restaurants nearby, code to transport links too
name: Panoramic city view, quiet neighborhood near metro

comments:
Super nice apartment, you feel right at home. The decor is a dream, the artwork gave a very warm and friendly feeling. It had everything we needed: a fully equipped kitchen, a comfortable bed, even small details that make a difference.
Can only recommend the accommodation!
name: Modern 1BR w/ Balcony | Local Athens Neighborhood

comments: Rich's place is approx 15 minutes walk to the city centre. On route to the centre you pass some great tavernas, bars and markets. If you don't fancy walking that far there are plenty of cafes, tavernas and bars within 5 minutes walk of the apartment. The area felt safe and relaxed. The odd noise from cats outside or local kids playing on the street-nothing of concern. I visited with my 18 month old and mother and found it very comfortable. I am also 5 months pregnant and found walking to the city very easy. The metro is also just around the corner should you wish to take it anywhere/travel from the airport using it. The wifi connection was excellent and the British television channels very much appreciated! The apartment has great security and I felt very happy to leave my belongings there. It was immaculately clean when we arrived and communication with Rich was excellent throughout the stay. Rich was very accommodating and bought a new potty & travel cot for my daughters use during our stay. We will absolutely be back. It's great value for money and perfect if you want a comfortable home away from home during your time in Athens.
name: Modern apartment in city centre - great location

comments: The only thing that I can say is that our experience was perfect in every way. We didn't get to meet Kalliopi, but we talked on the phone a couple of times. The flat is spacious and has very high quality fittings that Kalliopi understandably wants to look after. We loved the terrace and the comfortable living room. It is in a nice, quiet neighbourhood a comfortable walking distance from all of the main sights in the centre of Athens - there are a couple of good restaurants very close by and the shops are handy.
name: Value for money in Heart of Athens!

comments: super appart , nous étions juste de passage pour la nuit mais je recommande.  l'appart est au top !
name: Panoramic city view, quiet neighborhood near metro

comments: This is such a gem of a place to stay in Athens. Thank you Andreas! We will return.
name: SV Acropolis Residence - Garden Suite with Hot Tub

comments: My family and I (4 adults) stayed at Richard's apartment for two nights.  Richard was amazing in communicating with us to make sure that everything was fine.  He answered my questions instantly! The apartment was well equipped, comfortable, and spotless. The balcony was a plus.  The apartment is close to the metro and walking distance to the center. Gazi is full of restaurants.  We are going back!!!
name: Modern apartment in city centre - great location

comments:
The apartment was amazyng especially the view from the living room balcony....
spent so many hours on this balcony....

Everything is just around the corner in this greek local neighbourhood...

I recommend this apartment for fore balcony people....

p.s the internet is super...

Best regards Einar & Einar
name: Urban Forty One | Acropolis-view penthouse

comments: The owner of this house, Rich made sure that we were completely informed about everything before we even got there. check-in went very smoothly with the keysafe and during our stay we could always relay on Rich. it's only a 20 minute walk from the heart of the city and for younger people, also close to nice bars. We recommend this airbnb!
name: Modern apartment in city centre - great location

comments:
We really enjoyed our time in Athens! Soula's flat is in a great location - about a 15 minute walk to the Acropolis and all the shopping and restaurants you could want.
Soula kept in contact during our stay and her friend Eleni was an absolute pleasure to deal with.
The balcony was a great space to spend time at the end of the day with a glass of wine and conversation :).
name: Unique Central Artistic Flat Athens

comments: We struck lucky with this lovely apartment, a perfectly placed sanctuary in Plaka within walking distance of Athens' ancient sites. Our host Anna was super speedy and friendly with her correspondence on booking and went out of her way when our boat from Santorini was delayed, staying up to meet us at midnight! The flat had everything we needed (comfy bed, Wi-Fi, well equipped kitchen) and extra nice touches like the homemade jam in the fridge and handy toiletries in the bathroom. I loved the antique furniture in the lounge. She even gave us a Greek mobile if we needed to get hold of her. I would highly recommend staying here if you are ever in Athens - I am sad we couldn't extend our trip a little longer to maximise this brilliantly-located pad! Thanks Anna.
name: Vintage Apartment Athens, Plaka (Historic Center)

comments: Highly recommend you stay here. Andreas was an amazing host and offered many tips and recommendations for restaurants, activities and things to know about the area. The house was clean, comfortable and well maintained and is centrally located near everything. You could walk pretty much anywhere from the house. The hot tub was warm and felt great after walking around. We really enjoyed our stay and if you are in Athens, pick this place. If we return to Athens we would stay here again. It was fantastic!
name: SV Acropolis Residence - Garden Suite with Hot Tub

comments: Nice apartment, very close to the metro and the city center
name: Gazi Boutique Apartment 1

comments:
Anna was friendly and helpful throughout our stay. Her home was cozy and located very close to the main attractions of Athens as well as the bus and metro station. It was simple to arrive for the airport and transfer out to the train to Meteroa as well as to the port to catch our ferry.
Numerous tasty restaurants and lively bars and markets are located within walking distance as well. Would recommend to others and would stay again!
name: Vintage Apartment Athens, Plaka (Historic Center)

comments: Beautiful apartment, very nice and clean. Convenient location, supermarket is just downstairs. Subway is a little bit of walk but not too far.
name: Sunny appartment near Athens centre

comments: Wonderful place with a nice terrace and a comfortable bed. The family that rents the room out is really friendly. I‘d be happy to stay here again.
name: Sunny appartment near Athens centre

comments: Our stay in Kalliopi's apartment was perfect. It is situated very close (10 min walking) to the Acropolis Station but in a quite and silent zone.  Kalliopi is very helpful and she supports us on our requests. We will never forget the night view of the Acropolis from the terrace: amazing.
name: Value for money in Heart of Athens!

comments: Es war perfekt! immer wieder gerne!
name: Sunny appartment near Athens centre

comments: This was the perfect first place to stay on our trek around Greece! We loved this place and it was everything we had hoped it would be. It was such a wonderful location with so many great places to eat all around us, not to mention the bed was a divine comfortable sanctuary after a long day of walking and exploring. 10 out of 10 would highly recommend! Thank you Agis!
name: Athens AVATON - Parthenon Suite

comments: Close vicinity to all of the ancient attractions, shopping areas, great restaurants and beautiful cocktail bars. Had the best time sraying here!
name: Studio Under Acropolis Rock

comments:
My stay at Pygmalion's place was absolutely wonderful! Everything went smooth. I arrived late and Pygmalion waited for me in the apartment, he met me personally, showed the apartment and even arranged the taxi I needed next morning.
The apartment looked exactly as on the pictures and had all facilities as described.
The host was friendly, stayed in touch throughout all my stay and we met for a coffee as well.
The neighbourhood was calm and friendly and subway station was just 5 minutes away.
Overall, it was a pleasure to stay at Pygmalion's place. I'd be glad to come again.
name: Modern 1BR w/ Balcony | Local Athens Neighborhood

comments:
Apartment is nicely centrally located. Not far from Monastiraki metro station and Monastiraki square with its restaurants and shops. Apartment was clean and Mr. Dimitris was of a great help during our stay.
Only downside was music from nearby nightclub on Fri and Sat night, going on until early in the morning.
name: Hermes Historical Center apt.

comments: Please pick this place if you are looking for a great place to stay during your time in Athens. The location was outstanding and we were close to all the sights we wanted to see. The people in the neighborhood  were very friendly and helped us out always. Agis responded very fast and was pleasant all the time. The Penthouse was remarkable and the views are breathtaking. I highly recommend that you book this place if you are looking for a great Athens experience.!
name: Athens AVATON - Parthenon Suite

comments:
great location!!
Anna is quite helpful n response fast!
really good stay like home!
thanks so much for your hospitality!
we will definitly come back again!!
name: Vintage Apartment Athens, Plaka (Historic Center)

comments:
Die von Haris zur Verfügung gestellte Wohnung ist von der Lage her sehr toll. Man ist mittendrin und kann zu Fuß alle Stadtteile super schnell erreichen. Die Wohnung ist sehr gut aufgeteilt und bietet einen großen Tisch zum Frühstücken und eine gut ausgestattete Küche. Auch das Bad ist sehr schön!
Haris ist ein sehr zuvorkommender AirBnB Host und gibt sich große Mühe, um sich als Gast in seiner Heimat wohl zu fühlen!
name: Quiet Courtyard • 2BR • 95sqm • Acropolis Walk

comments:
Very nice flat at a definitely more than reasonable rate. Communication was just perfect and very helpful. It wasn't even an issue that I arrived somewhat late. Very quiet area, nice view from the top of the roof - but there are restaurants and clubs around at 5 minutes walk. Supermarket and late-night shops right across the street.
The flat itself was quite nice, on top of that there was breakfast, some fruit and hard-boiled eggs. Definite recommendation!
name: Sunny appartment near Athens centre

comments: Communication was very prompt. Check-in was easy and great location for exploring Athens.
name: Studio Under Acropolis Rock

comments:
Haris is a great host, very responsive and super friendly. Checking in went really smoothly, in fact he was at the door to greet us when we arrived. He made sure we were settled in, answered all our queries before he left. He also booked us a cab to the airport for checkout-day.
A very charming apartment, with modern-chic Greek vibes. Great location with supermarkets and convenient stores nearby.
name: Quiet Courtyard • 2BR • 95sqm • Acropolis Walk

comments: Nasos was a perfect host. He showed us the way to the apartment and gave us good tips for sightseeing and restaurants. We enjoyed our trip to Athens very much. The apartment is very well located and extremely quiet. We can absolutely recommend it.
name: Studio Under Acropolis Rock

comments: Great location!!! Loved walking to all the attractions. We didn’t even need to purchase subway tickets!
name: Studio Under Acropolis Rock

comments: This apartment has plenty of space for two people.  Its a bit odd to have the shower in the kitchen, but you can lower the shutter and actually have quite a bit of privacy.  It really isn't bad.  The balcony is great.  There is a great view.  The apartment is also located close to several bus lines so getting around the city was quite easy.
name: Sunny appartment near Athens centre

comments: We couldn't have picked a better place for our Athens trip. The apartment was amazing, gorgeous Acropolis view, located in the heart of Monastiraki, walking distance to restaurants and shops, like the Ermou shopping street, Syntagma square, and of course, the Acropolis. The apartment has everything we needed, including a washer and dryer (nice touch) which is right outside the hall. My hysband and I had a wonderful time and would love to come back next time we are in Athens.
name: Athens AVATON - Parthenon Suite

comments: Nasos was such a great host! So kind and welcoming and the place was exactly as described. Easy to see why he is a Super Host! This place isn't to be missed.
name: Studio Under Acropolis Rock

comments:
Anna´s place is just like advertised, comfortable, cosy and a really walking distance from the acropolis (about 15 min).
Close of the Zeus Temple / Adrianos Arch, the plaka zone for shopping and restaurants, ancient Agora and really to all the important spots !!!.
A friend of mine who lives in Pireaus / Athens, ssaid that the location could not be better.
The bazaar (supermarket) is very close, also you have restaurants and very important, bus station from to the airport is just three blocks away and you can save good money instead of using a taxi, this bus is not a normal city bus, is prepared with room for the lugagge.
Anna was also very nice, helped me out and the reception with wine and snacks was fenomenal.
I highly reccommend her place.
name: Vintage Apartment Athens, Plaka (Historic Center)

comments: Great value for money! Katerina was very kind and helpful- staying up til early morning to check us in and give us Easter cookies too! Close to the metro so the cente is accessible with a metro card.
name: Spacious Cosy aprtm very close to Metro!

comments: Super quartier que celui d’Exarcheia, loin des artifices branchouilles de Psyri ou la surexploitation de Plaka pour le tourisme. L’appartement est à l’image du quartier, aucune trace de gentrification! La terrasse est super, même si les plantes manquent de soin, ainsi que le mobilier et globalement l’appartement. Mais la situation compense ces désagréments qui n’en sont que pour les plus pointilleux.
name: LUSCIOUS ROOF GARDEN IN THE CENTER!

comments: Rich was very responsive. He gave us tips on where to eat. Apartment very clean. Apartment complex very quiet. Didn’t hear a thing. Walked into main part of Athens in around 25 mins. Felt safe. Would recommend you to stay.
name: Modern apartment in city centre - great location

comments:
Anna is very hospitable, kind and friendly.
The apartment's location is excellent, in the city center, within walking distance to popular locations (Acropolis, Plaka, Monastiraki), and 1-2 minutes walk from Syntagma metro station.
Anna was very kind into allowing us a very early check-in, and also allowing a late check-out. Welcoming was very friendly and the house was filled with perks, such as fresh oranges, transitional Greek suits (melomakarona), and handmade marmelades from her mother.
We will definitely try to stay there in our next trip.
name: Vintage Apartment Athens, Plaka (Historic Center)

comments:
Dear Soula,
Thank you very much for the beautiful apartment. It was absolutely perfect for our family. The flat was clean, spacious and close enough to the city centre. We recommend it to everyone who travels to Athens!
Thanks again: Oszter family
name: Unique Central Artistic Flat Athens

comments: It is hosts and properties like Ilias's that have converted me from a hotel bookers to Air BnB.Right from the time we booked the trip we had a very pleasant experience .The apartment is a fabulous with high ceilings and impressive little touches all around the apartment. We travelled with our 8 year old daughter who absolutely loved Ilias's place. I am not surprised at all the 5 star reviews as this place indeed is perfect. Ilias and his father Niko were super helpful,the local restaurant suggestions were fantastic and they even arranged a trip to a beautiful beach outside of Athens for us. The apartment is as listed unlike a few other photoshopped apartments that I have been to, the neighbourhood is residential and quiet. There are a lot of options for food and drink and the acropolis or other attractions are around a 15 minute walk. We walked everywhere from the Acropolis to Plaka and even mount Lycabettus (which is not walkable from this location but we are a crazy family).Overall I highly recommend the house on the hill and if you want to truly have a greek experience and stay among locals this is the place for you.Thanks Ilias for everything.
name: By the hill

comments: Petit nid perché avec terrasse et vue sue les collines d'athènes dans le quartier jeune et animé de Kipseli, idéal pour quelques jours à Athènes. Accueil et organisation sans faille.
name: Sunny appartment near Athens centre

comments:
Amaxing location & personal touches by our host Anna!
Loved our house in the Plaka district of Athens!
name: Vintage Apartment Athens, Plaka (Historic Center)

comments: Very nice appartement, well located.
name: Modern apartment in city centre - great location

comments: It was a truly wonderful experience. Everything that was described was exactly as promised. Rich was a remarcable host. Although we didn't meet him in person, he was always present, caring, attentive and fothcoming - through his e-mail which were fast and accurate. The neighbourhood is quite lively, but the flat itself is located in a very secluded and quiet street, except of the school next door ( but that was ok). It is only 2-3 minutes walking distance from the metro station, so that was perfect, too.The flat is very clean, well equiped and the terrace is exeptional. We couldn't wish for anything more, so anybody wanting a safe, relaxed and a very, very good stay in Athens feel free to book with Rich.
name: Modern apartment in city centre - great location

comments: Alkis is a great host. The apartment is great with exquisit emenities.
name: Gazi Boutique Apartment 2

comments: Appartement très sympa et très bien situé (metro à moins de 5min, marché dans la rue et des commerces à proximité). Pygmalion a été très agréable et avenant ! Nous recommandons vivement !
name: Modern 1BR w/ Balcony | Local Athens Neighborhood
